agent.problem: Saying Herodias 'has been waiting a long time' adds a duration the passage does not give. Mark says she held a grudge, wanted to kill John and later received an opportunity, but never says how long she waited.

rule.text: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

agent.problem: The card's observation that the girl repeats her mother's answer 'word for word' uses the mother's wording in Mark 6:24 as well as the girl's request in Mark 6:25. Citing only Mark 6:25 is too narrow; the card should cite Mark 6:24-25.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
